text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup has finally 
begun. The crowd goes wild over the clash 
of princesses(?) between Fine Motion and 
Kawakami Princess!

Air Shakur was also present in the stands. 
Seemingly there to confirm something, she 
fixed Fine Motion with a stern gaze.

Fine Motion herself was thrilled about the 
dream match...! Though bewildered by the 
competitive fire awakening within her, she 
vowed to give it her all.
